name: lua-x
description: LUA-X — AI-native development studio for Roblox creators.

scripts.sync:check: npm run sync:plugin:check && npm run sync:studio-handler:check
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/shared && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/animation-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/autonomous-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/cloud-core && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/execution-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/fusion-core && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/hardening-core && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/nvidia-provider && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/orchestrator && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/project-index && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/roblox-mcp-bridge && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/sync-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/ui-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/verification-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/world-engine && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/api-core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/api && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run sync:studio-handler && npm run sync:plugin && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@lua-x/web
scripts.check: npm run sync:check && npm run check:api && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
